versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Refi Break-Even Ranger.
- Computes true break-even months for mortgage refinancing, factoring in closing costs, points, and monthly savings.
- Analyzes and compares multiple lender offers side by side, including impact of cash-out and changes in term.
- Accounts for amortization reset and user’s real stay-horizon, guarding against common refinance traps.
- Delivers a plain verdict (REFI / STAY / ONLY-IF-YOU-STAY) and net lifetime saving calculation.
